topic: Ten Red Flags Before Buying a Commercial Property
caption:
Before you sign on a commercial purchase, spotting red flags is your best defense. This lesson walks through ten common warning signs — from structural problems and unpermitted work to environmental concerns, lease issues, and hidden costs — that can turn a promising deal into a costly headache. Use this checklist to guide inspections, ask targeted questions, and decide when to negotiate credits, order specialized reports, or simply walk away. Bring in a structural engineer, environmental consultant, and experienced attorney when concerns arise. For investors, landlords, and business owners in Chester County and Montgomery County, PA, many older buildings or mixed-use sites warrant extra scrutiny.
